acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a commercial bathroom renovation in the Los Angeles area depends on various factors, such as the size of the space, the quality of materials chosen, the extent of plumbing and electrical work required, and compliance with local building codes and ADA standards. Basic remodels might start from a certain price point, while custom designs with high-end finishes and significant layout changes will be considerably more.
